_comment: SET INDICES source of truth. Written at inception by the build session (Aug 24 2026); appended weekly by the Monday trend-scan STEP 3.6 re-mark. SCHEMA per index: base (always 100.00), inception, divisor (current), divisorLog[{date, before, after, why}], universe[{num, name, rarity}] (ALL slots in scope, priced or not), basket[{num, name, rarity, price, basis, asOf}] (only cards with sourced SOLD reads), history[{date, level, basketValue, divisor, priced, note}]. MATH: level = sum(basket prices) / divisor. INCLUSION (a universe card gets its first sourced sold comp): newDivisor = oldDivisor * (basketValueAfter / basketValueBefore) -- the level MUST be identical before and after; log it in divisorLog. RULES: sold comps only, dated + attributed, never asks, never estimated; base/inception/history rows are immutable; an index is a measurement, not a call. ADDENDUM Aug 24: universeComplete=false means the secret-tier enumeration is partial (API down at build) — STEP 3.6 must complete the universe list from pokemontcg.io before or during the next re-mark. ACTIVATION RULE: a pre-activation index (status=pre-activation, divisor null) activates when the weekly re-mark sources its first point sold reads — set divisor = basketValue/100 on that date, set inception, write history row level 100.00, flip status to live. DR25 also needs its universe enumerated (sv10 was down at build). MOVERS ADDENDUM (Aug 31 2026): basket entries carry prevPrice/prevAsOf = the prior weekly mark, so /indices renders card-level movers client-side; STEP 3.6 must roll these forward each re-mark (prevPrice <- old price) before writing new marks. New inclusions have no prevPrice until their second mark.

BCB26._heldNote: LANE-RULES R20 (2026-09-23): no new eBay-listing-derived level until the sold-basis rebuild (R21, Sep 30). Pages show the last level and this date.
BCB26._note: PRE-ACTIVATION per-set Bowman index #1 (built 2026-09-07 by bcb26-index-prebuild, charter 4.8). Universe rows use {id, number, player, team, tab, first?, board?} (the Pokémon tickers use {num, name, rarity}; /indices reads only .length). basket rows, once STEP 3.6 writes them: {id, number, player, tab, price, basis:'ask (eBay verified, engine)'|'sold (SCP)', asOf, units?, prevPrice?, prevAsOf?}. AUTOS 15% single-card cap = fractional units at (re)constitution, logged in divisorLog. Activation: first re-mark where verified asks cover ≥60% of chase-basket value → divisor = basketValue/100, inception = that date, history[0] = {level 100.00}, status 'live', basis stays 'ask' (labeled on-page) until ≥60% SCP sold coverage → restate to 'sold' via a logged divisor adjustment (level identical before/after). Never blend asks and solds in one basket. Re-marks: every board-touching run (Mon/Tue/Fri) through street+21d, then weekly.

BCB26.activationRule: COUNT basis (restated 2026-09-11 by the CoS - on an ask basis an unverified card has no value, so a value-share gate was unmeasurable): activates on the first re-mark where >=60% of chase-basket CARDS (>=6 of 9 in v1) carry an engine-verified ask (>=4 verified listings); divisor = basket value / 100, inception = that date, level 100.00. Restates to hammer basis via a logged divisor adjustment at >=60% SCP sold coverage.
BCB26.chaseBasketNote: CHASE BASKET v1 (CoS ruling 2026-09-11, charter 4.8). The universe is every checklist card; the CHASE BASKET is the bounded subset the engine actually feeds and the activation gate is measured on. v1 = the cards the site itself already names as the chase on /bowman-chrome-baseball-2026: Ethan Holliday BCP-209 (board-flagged base) + the four 2026 IFA headliners' 1st Bowman Chrome Prospect Autos (Luis Hernandez CPA-LH, Wandy Asigen CPA-WA, Francisco Renteria CPA-FR, Angeibel Gomez CPA-AG) and their 1st Bowman base cards (BCP-200/152/163/194). Grows only via the Tuesday STEP 0 release synthesis, each addition a logged divisor adjustment. Feeds carry boardHide:true (Signal Board stays 2026 paper-class).

BOW26._basisNote: ASK-BASIS ACTIVATION (Mo, Sep 4 2026 directive — supersedes the sold-only rule above for Bowman indices): constituent marks are the price engine's nightly verified ask-floor medians for the exact card (verifyListings, 7f1d51c). Labeled 'ask basis' on the page. When hammer coverage reaches ~60% of basket value (market-latest.json, inside 30 days), restate the divisor to hammer basis — the level never moves on a basis change; log it in divisorLog. Level moves nightly, computed client-side from prices-history.json with the fixed units + divisor here.
